sources.document_title: TE Connectivity FASTON Terminals and Connectors, Section Catalog 1654369-1 (Main Catalog 1654400-1, Chapter 24)
sources.locator: Introduction page, Performance Data section, Current Rating row
sources.evidence_extract: TE Connectivity FASTON Terminals and Connectors, Section Catalog 1654369-1 (Main Catalog 1654400-1, Chapter 24, Issued 4-2010), Introduction page. Performance Data: Current Rating 20 A max with 2.5 mm2 wire size; for steel-nickel plated versions use 16 A max with 2.5 mm2 wire size. Series-level rating for the FASTON .250/.187/.110 receptacle/tab family (brass/phosphor-bronze/steel contacts, tin/silver/nickel plating); not broken out per individual MPN. 63951-1's own plating (tin over nickel underplate, non-steel) matches the non-derated 20 A lane, not the steel-nickel-plated 16 A lane.

sources.locator: Symbol 1217754-1 property row 'LCSC Part' = 'C305825'; pin rows 1 and 2 (unspecified line pins)
sources.evidence_extract: Symbol '1217754-1' (easyeda2kicad import; original footprint field easyeda2kicad:CONN-TH_1217754-1) carries hidden property 'LCSC Part' = 'C305825' -- a different LCSC identifier than the project's actual ordered/inventoried C591344 for J6-J9. Defines two generic pins numbered '1' and '2' (names literally '1'/'2', no functional/polarity naming); symbol pin numbers equal footprint pad numbers.

Footprint CONN-TH_1217754-1 (easyeda2kicad, through_hole attr) defines two THT pads: pad 1 rect, pad 2 circle, both size 2.20mm, drill ~1.40mm -- matches the TE FASTON 'PCB Hole Diameter 1.4 mm' spec printed on the 63951-1 sheet. Symbol pin numbers equal footprint pad numbers (1, 2).

sources.evidence_extract: board-b.json intentionally excludes J6-J11 from its resolved Ref.Pin nets (note: 'Output Connectors (J6-J11)... intentionally NOT included in nets below -- see unresolved'). unresolved reasons cite J7/J6/J8 Faston tabs by name: 'PTC1.2, TVS1, J7 Faston tabs, and J10/J11 pins 7-8 are documented only via a Ref-only Faston table, a pin-range Eurorack table, and a mermaid block diagram -- no Ref.Pin net table entry exists to baseline without guessing pin numbers' (same pattern for J6/-12V and J8/+5V); the GND(output stage) entry: 'gives J9/J10/J11 GND membership only via a Ref-only Faston table and a pin-range Eurorack table, not Ref.Pin tokens... merging into the already-resolved GND net above would require guessing which physical pins are meant.'
As-ordered v0.4.0 BOM row: value 63951-1, refdes J6,J7,J8,J9, footprint CONN-TH_1217754-1, LCSC C591344, quantity 4.
